extName.description: Extension name shown in the toolbar and extension list.

extDescription.message: Save papers to your CiteBox library with one click, Zotero Connector style.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the extension list.

popupHeader.description: Header of the browser action popup.

notConfigured.message: Server URL or integration token is not configured yet.
notConfigured.description: Shown in the popup when settings are missing.

openOptions.description: Button that opens the options page.

cannotReadPage.message: Cannot read this page. It may be a restricted page or not fully loaded.
cannotReadPage.description: Shown when the content script cannot be reached on the current tab.

labelTitle.description: Label for the detected paper title.

notDetected.description: Placeholder when title or DOI was not found on the page.

saveToCitebox.description: Primary button in the popup that triggers the import.

saving.description: In-progress label of the save button.

imported.description: Shown when the server accepted the import (HTTP 202).

alreadyExists.message: This paper is already in your library.
alreadyExists.description: Shown when the server reports a duplicate (HTTP 409).

openInCitebox.description: Link to view the paper in the CiteBox web UI.

checkToken.message: Unauthorized (HTTP 401). Please check your integration token in the settings.
checkToken.description: Shown when the server rejects the token.

noPdfFound.message: No directly downloadable PDF found on this page.
noPdfFound.description: Error when neither a DOI import nor a PDF download is possible.

networkError.description: Error when a fetch fails before receiving a response.

missingToken.message: Integration token is missing. Open the settings to configure it.
missingToken.description: Error when an import is attempted without a token.

unknownError.description: Fallback error text when the server gave no message.

serverUrlLabel.description: Label for the server address input.

serverUrlPlaceholder.description: Placeholder for the server address input.

testConnection.description: Button that tests server reachability and token validity.

testing.description: In-progress label of the test connection button.

testSuccess.message: Connection successful. Server and token are working.
testSuccess.description: Shown when the test request returns HTTP 200.

testInvalidToken.message: The token is invalid (HTTP 401). Generate a new one in CiteBox settings.
testInvalidToken.description: Shown when the test request returns HTTP 401.

testUnreachable.message: Cannot reach the server. Check the URL and make sure CiteBox is running.
testUnreachable.description: Shown when the test request fails at the network level.

testHttpError.description: Shown when the test request returns an unexpected status code.

fillRequired.message: Please fill in both the server URL and the integration token.
fillRequired.description: Validation message when required fields are empty.
